summary: Platform-oriented senior software engineer experienced deploying, operating, modernizing, and troubleshooting production applications, databases, integrations, and analytical pipelines.

facts: Developed, deployed, and maintained production applications for startups and small businesses.
Worked with Vercel and Azure deployments, GitHub-based delivery workflows, Docker, environment configuration, domains, authentication, databases, and external services.
Maintained long-running client systems and acted as the technical point of contact for production changes and troubleshooting.
strongFraming: Emphasize end-to-end operational ownership rather than limiting the story to feature development.
Use for deployment automation, environment separation, secrets, incident response, rollback planning, and production support.

facts: Supported a real-time messaging product serving more than 30,000 users.
Owned changes spanning application behavior, SQL-backed data flows, real-time communication, and automated moderation.
strongFraming: Use for availability, scaling, database performance, safe releases, observability, and operational risk in an active community.

facts: Modernized an operational administration portal managing more than 10,000 active lines and more than 50 administrative views.
Worked directly with the CTO inside a system where changes affected ongoing telecommunications operations.
strongFraming: Use for staged modernization, backwards compatibility, deployment risk, operational tooling, and working around legacy constraints.

facts: Partnered with central IT during cloud migration of source data used by executive reporting systems.
Standardized dependencies on fragmented Access, VBA, SAS, and SQL workflows before or during migration.
strongFraming: Use for migration planning, dependency discovery, data validation, legacy-system risk, and cross-team platform work.

facts: Reverse-engineered undocumented reporting pipelines and rewrote their logic in maintainable R and Python workflows.
Reduced knowledge-loss risk and improved the reliability of recurring internal reporting.
strongFraming: Use for automation, repeatability, runbook thinking, eliminating fragile manual dependencies, and reliability engineering for data systems.

facts: Uses separate development and production environments so changes can be validated before release.
Has worked with database schema changes, migrations, GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel deployments, and third-party service configuration.
strongFraming: Use for CI/CD, release discipline, configuration management, migration safety, and reducing deployment risk.
